# Fixtures for `m4a` (MPEG-4 audio)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. The audio is a
synthetic sine tone; titles, names and labels (Saltmere Brass Band, Mira Castell, Ana
Lighthouse, Example Records) are fictitious. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/audio.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `bells-alac-coreaudio.m4a` | macOS `afconvert`, Apple Lossless (its `mvhd` times are those of the run) | CC0-1.0 |
| `bells-ffmpeg.m4a` | ffmpeg 7.1, AAC-LC with iTunes tags and JPEG cover art | CC0-1.0 |
| `tour-chapters-ffmpeg.m4b` | ffmpeg 7.1 (`ipod` muxer), audiobook with a chapter text track | CC0-1.0 |
